sessions.prompt: My landlord is refusing to return my security deposit.

response.summary: Security deposit dispute with your landlord regarding unpaid return of deposits.
response.clarificationNeeded: 1. Did you provide a formal written vacancy notice? 2. Is there a signed tenancy agreement? 3. Has the landlord provided a written list of deductions?
response.explanation: Under the Model Tenancy Act guidelines, a landlord must return the advance security deposit within 30 days of the tenant vacating the premises. Deductions are only permitted for actual damage or unpaid dues, not for normal wear and tear.
nextSteps: Send a written demand notice requesting the return of the deposit within 15 days.
Compile evidence including the tenancy agreement, bank transactions, and photos of the vacant room.
If the landlord refuses, prepare a petition to be filed before the local Rent Authority/Tribunal.
documentsNeeded: Rent Receipts / Bank statement showing deposit payment

sources.title: Security Deposit Return Guidelines under Model Tenancy Act
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (Delhi State Rent Guidelines)
sources.content: According to Chapter IV of the Model Tenancy Act, the security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall: (a) not exceed two months' rent in case of residential premises; and (b) not exceed six months' rent in case of non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant by the landlord at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making due deduction of any liability of the tenant (such as unpaid rent, utility bills, or cost of repairing tenant-caused structural damage). If the landlord fails to refund the security deposit or make adjustments within 30 days of the tenant vacating the premises, the tenant has the right to file a dispute petition before the Rent Authority or Rent Tribunal.

[Office of the Public Works Department / Municipal Corporation],

Subject: Request for Information under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act, 2005.

Sir/Madam,

I, a citizen of India, hereby request the following information regarding the road construction and funds spent in my locality:

1. Please provide details of total budget allocated, sanctioned, and released for road construction, repair, and resurfacing in [SPECIFIC LOCALITY / WARD NUMBER] during the last 3 financial years.
2. Please provide a copy of the Work Order, Tender Notice, and completion certificate for work done on [SPECIFY ROAD NAME] in the past 24 months.

Place: [Your City]

Applicant:
Name: Sampreeth Racharla
Address: Delhi
Phone: [Your Contact Number]
instructions: Buy a Rs. 10 Court Fee Stamp or Postal Order (IPO) payable to the Accounts Officer of the public authority.
Fill in your name and address in the placeholders in the draft above.
Submit via Registered Post/Speed Post to the correct PIO or file online at rtionline.gov.in.

sources.title: Filing RTI for Local Road Construction and Fund Allocation
sources.authority: Central Information Commission / Right to Information Act 2005
guidelines: Under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act 2005, a citizen can request details about expenditures, copies of work orders, measurement books (MB), and completion certificates.
Be specific about the road name, ward number, locality, and the exact years or date range.
Do not ask for reasons or opinions; ask for records, documents, contracts, or file notes.
Address the application to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the respective public authority (e.g. Executive Engineer, PWD or Ward Assistant Commissioner).
sample_questions: What is the total budget allocated and sanctioned for the construction/repair of [Road Name/Locality] during the period [Start Year] to [End Year]?
Please provide a certified copy of the Work Order, Tender Document, and agreement signed with the contractor for the aforementioned work.
Please provide the copy of the completion certificate and measurement book entries for this work.
If the road has developed potholes/cracks, please provide the details of the liability period of the contractor and what action has been taken by the department.

response.disclaimer: This is a draft RTI application requiring your review and verification. Ensure all local names and addresses are filled out accurately.

response.explanation: Under the Model Tenancy Act guidelines, a landlord must return the advance security deposit within 30 days of the tenant vacating the premises. Deductions are only permitted for actual damage or unpaid dues, not for normal wear and tear.
nextSteps: Send a written demand notice requesting the return of the deposit within 15 days.
Compile evidence including the tenancy agreement, bank transactions, and photos of the vacant room.
If the landlord refuses, prepare a petition to be filed before the local Rent Authority/Tribunal.
documentsNeeded: Rent Receipts / Bank statement showing deposit payment

sources.title: Security Deposit Return Guidelines under Model Tenancy Act
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (Delhi State Rent Guidelines)
sources.content: According to Chapter IV of the Model Tenancy Act, the security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall: (a) not exceed two months' rent in case of residential premises; and (b) not exceed six months' rent in case of non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant by the landlord at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making due deduction of any liability of the tenant (such as unpaid rent, utility bills, or cost of repairing tenant-caused structural damage). If the landlord fails to refund the security deposit or make adjustments within 30 days of the tenant vacating the premises, the tenant has the right to file a dispute petition before the Rent Authority or Rent Tribunal.

response.subject: Information request under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 regarding local road construction and fund allocation.
response.targetAuthority: Public Information Officer (PIO), Public Works Department (PWD) / Municipal Corporation
response.rtiDraft:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
[Office of the Public Works Department / Municipal Corporation],
[City / District Name]

Subject: Request for Information under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act, 2005.

Sir/Madam,

I, a citizen of India, hereby request the following information regarding the road construction and funds spent in my locality:

1. Please provide details of total budget allocated, sanctioned, and released for road construction, repair, and resurfacing in [SPECIFIC LOCALITY / WARD NUMBER] during the last 3 financial years.
2. Please provide a copy of the Work Order, Tender Notice, and completion certificate for work done on [SPECIFY ROAD NAME] in the past 24 months.
3. What is the name of the contractor/agency selected for this road work, and what is the specified defect liability period?
4. Please provide a copy of the measurement book entries corresponding to this construction.

Please provide the information in print format. I am enclosing the RTI Application Fee of Rs. 10/- via Postal Order/Demand Draft.

Date: 19/8/2026
Place: [Your City]

Applicant:
Name: Sampreeth Racharla
Address: Delhi
Phone: [Your Contact Number]
instructions: Buy a Rs. 10 Court Fee Stamp or Postal Order (IPO) payable to the Accounts Officer of the public authority.
Fill in your name and address in the placeholders in the draft above.
Submit via Registered Post/Speed Post to the correct PIO or file online at rtionline.gov.in.

sources.title: Filing RTI for Local Road Construction and Fund Allocation
sources.authority: Central Information Commission / Right to Information Act 2005
guidelines: Under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act 2005, a citizen can request details about expenditures, copies of work orders, measurement books (MB), and completion certificates.
Be specific about the road name, ward number, locality, and the exact years or date range.
Do not ask for reasons or opinions; ask for records, documents, contracts, or file notes.
Address the application to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the respective public authority (e.g. Executive Engineer, PWD or Ward Assistant Commissioner).
sample_questions: What is the total budget allocated and sanctioned for the construction/repair of [Road Name/Locality] during the period [Start Year] to [End Year]?
Please provide a certified copy of the Work Order, Tender Document, and agreement signed with the contractor for the aforementioned work.
Please provide the copy of the completion certificate and measurement book entries for this work.
If the road has developed potholes/cracks, please provide the details of the liability period of the contractor and what action has been taken by the department.
